title: CrestApps Dispatch configuration
description: The settings of the Dispatch module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

Mobile.description: The technician app (the Technician Mobile feature).

OfflineDays.description: How many days after today the app keeps visits for, offline.

PingIntervalSeconds.description: How often the app sends the technician's position while they work, in seconds.

LocationRetentionDays.description: How long positions are kept, in days.

ReceiptRetentionDays.description: How long the records of the app's commands are kept, in days; a command sent again after that is applied again.

ConsentNoticeVersion.description: The version of the location notice. Change it when the notice changes, so technicians agree again.

MaxFileKilobytes.description: The largest photo or signature accepted, in kilobytes.

MaxCommandsPerSync.description: The most commands taken in one sync; the app sends the rest next.
